{
  "name": "sistema-os",
  "version": "0.1.1",
  "private": true,
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "next dev --webpack",
    "build": "next build --webpack",
    "start": "next start",
    "lint": "eslint",
    "prisma:generate": "prisma generate",
    "backup": "node scripts/backup-local.js",
    "restore": "node scripts/restore-local.js",
    "backup:auto": "node scripts/backup-auto.js",
    "pacote": "node scripts/criar-pacote-local.js",
    "sqlite:env": "node scripts/preparar-env-sqlite-local.js",
    "local:prepare": "npm run prisma:generate && npm run build",
    "desktop": "electron desktop/main.cjs",
    "desktop:servidor": "electron desktop/main.cjs --servidor",
    "desktop:cliente": "electron desktop/main.cjs --cliente",
    "desktop:prepare": "npm run seed:sqlite && node scripts/preparar-standalone-desktop.js",
    "desktop:dir": "npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --dir",
    "desktop:portable": "npm run local:prepare && npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --win portable",
    "desktop:installer": "npm run local:prepare && electron-builder --win nsis",
    "desktop:release": "npm run local:prepare && npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --win portable nsis",
    "desktop:win": "npm run local:prepare && npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --win",
    "desktop:instalador": "npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder",
    "seed:sqlite": "node scripts/criar-seed-sqlite-limpo.cjs"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@prisma/client": "6.19.3",
    "next": "^16.2.10",
    "pdfkit": "^0.19.1",
    "qrcode": "^1.5.4",
    "react": "^19.2.4",
    "react-dom": "^19.2.4"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@tailwindcss/postcss": "^4",
    "@types/node": "^20",
    "@types/pdfkit": "^0.17.6",
    "@types/qrcode": "^1.5.6",
    "@types/react": "^19",
    "@types/react-dom": "^19",
    "electron": "^43.2.0",
    "electron-builder": "^26.15.3",
    "eslint": "^9",
    "eslint-config-next": "16.2.10",
    "prisma": "6.19.3",
    "tailwindcss": "^4",
    "typescript": "^5"
  },
  "main": "desktop/main.cjs",
  "build": {
    "appId": "br.com.nioos.desktop",
    "productName": "Nio-OS",
    "copyright": "Copyright © 2026 Nio-OS",
    "asar": false,
    "directories": {
      "output": "release",
      "buildResources": "build"
    },
    "files": [
      "desktop/**/*",
      ".next/standalone/**/*",
      ".next/standalone/.next/static/**/*",
      ".next/standalone/public/**/*",
      "public/**/*",
      "prisma/**/*",
      "package.json",
      "!data/**/*",
      "!backups/**/*",
      "!storage/**/*",
      "!public/uploads/**/*",
      "!.next/standalone/data/**/*",
      "!.next/standalone/backups/**/*",
      "!.next/standalone/storage/**/*",
      "!.next/standalone/public/uploads/**/*",
      "desktop/**",
      "prisma/**",
      "scripts/**",
      "public/**",
      ".next/standalone/**",
      ".next/static/**",
      "node_modules/**",
      "!logs-build-*/*",
      "!_patch_desktop_*/*",
      "!data/**",
      "!backups/**",
      "!release/**",
      "!dist-local/**"
    ],
    "extraMetadata": {
      "main": "desktop/main.cjs"
    },
    "win": {
      "target": [
        {
          "target": "nsis",
          "arch": [
            "x64"
          ]
        },
        {
          "target": "dir",
          "arch": [
            "x64"
          ]
        }
      ],
      "artifactName": "${productName}-${version}-${arch}.${ext}",
      "icon": "build/icon.png",
      "requestedExecutionLevel": "asInvoker"
    },
    "portable": {
      "artifactName": "${productName}-Portable-${version}-${arch}.${ext}"
    },
    "nsis": {
      "oneClick": false,
      "allowToChangeInstallationDirectory": true,
      "createDesktopShortcut": true,
      "createStartMenuShortcut": true,
      "shortcutName": "Nio-OS",
      "perMachine": false,
      "allowElevation": true,
      "deleteAppDataOnUninstall": false,
      "artifactName": "Nio-OS Setup ${version}.${ext}"
    },
    "executableName": "Nio-OS",
    "publish": null,
    "extraResources": [
      {
        "from": "build/seed/data",
        "to": "seed/data",
        "filter": [
          "nio-os.db"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "afterPack": "scripts/electron-afterpack-v11n.js"
  },
  "description": "Sistema local de ordem de servico Nio-OS",
  "author": "Nio-OS"
}
